verdict.rationale: The only evidence of API versioning is the `/v1/` segment in the OpenAI-compatible base URL. Nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme, deprecation policy, model-retirement notice, or changelog, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit API versioning policy, notice periods for breaking changes or model retirement, a changelog, and independent corroboration.
